name: Improved Giant Form
body:
You may assume more powerful giant forms than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Giant Form class feature.

Benefit(s): You count as two levels higher for determining which giant forms you can assume, their powers, and how long they last. This feat does not increase the number of times per day you can assume giant form.

Special: This feat stacks with Extended Giant Form.
